summary: D.C. is advancing on multiple fronts related to local control and representation, including efforts to manage armory land near RFK Stadium while National Guard troops remain deployed in the district more than a year after their arrival. As midterm elections approach, statehood advocates are intensifying their campaign both locally and in other states, with at least one senator committing to prioritize the issue. Without statehood, D.C. residents have no voting representation in Congress, and Congress can override any law the District passes.
